problem.statement_latex: Given commuting elements $g_1,\ldots,g_k$ of a finite semigroup $S$ and $x\in S$, find nonnegative exponents $a_1,\ldots,a_k$ with $x=\prod_i g_i^{a_i}$, or report failure. Let $N=|S|$ and fix $k$.
problem.statement_text: Given commuting elements $g_1,\ldots,g_k$ of a finite semigroup $S$ and $x\in S$, find nonnegative exponents $a_1,\ldots,a_k$ with $x=\prod_i g_i^{a_i}$, or report failure. Let $N=|S|$ and fix $k$.
